newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Simsmetal sees Q2 down on Q1.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Simsmetal sees Q2 down on Q1.

text.p: Metals recycler Simsmetal Ltd said earnings in the three months to December 31, 1996, would be lower than the results recorded in the first quarter.
Simsmetal reported a 34 percent fall in net profit to A$8.28 million for the three months to September 30, 1996.

Managing director John Crabb said: "...as ferrous and non ferrous metal prices are now at their lowest level in almost four years, he expected trading conditions to remain difficult and earnings to be below those recorded in the first quarter."
"However, the company would continue with its strategy of improving unit costs and productivity," Crabb said.
Simsmetal reported an 18 percent fall in 1995/96 first half earnings to A$24.6 million.
At 11.35 a.m. (0135 GMT), Simsmetal shares were seven cents lower at A$7.07.
